name: av_treasury_yield
description:
US Treasury constant-maturity yield (percent) for one maturity from Alpha Vantage (TREASURY_YIELD), sampled monthly.
Returns: {name, interval, unit, data: [{date, value}]} with values as strings, newest first. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): maturity (3month, 2year, 5year, 7year, 10year or 30year; default 10year). The tool always asks for the monthly interval.
Other sources: fred_10yr_treasury, fred_2yr_treasury, fred_yield_spread; policy rate: av_fed_funds_rate.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"maturity": "2year"}
